Name: SCIE-Port 移植集合 (Audit Build)
Description: Authorized SCIE port for SCNET x25.01.17. v0.34.0 combines Gungnir V5.1/V5.1b native-anchored touch HUD and distinct outbound/return presentation with Mjolnir V6 artifact-slot skin, delayed lightning melee feedback, cyan damage numbers and the fake hammer's fixed lightning add-on. Gungnir ID 948, packet 244, combat values and throw movement remain unchanged. Android rendering, touch behavior, frame time and multiplayer visual acceptance remain pending device verification.
